new_information: actual post-action sampled drafts; actual future RNG is not exposed to policies
shared_semantic_action: updates h without changing current draft; later emissions may change both modalities

training.warm_start: matched supervised v7 recipe for each training seed
training.action_program: initial_prefix then fixed_policy; no adaptive policy during generator training
training.score: retained terminal image and token path likelihood; discarded independent draws Rao-Blackwellized only for the fixed action program
training.loss_argument: minus actual terminal utility; not the native differentiable surrogate
training.risk_target: joint task-and-generation exponential moment; not mean task-conditional CE
training.gradient_estimator: unbiased score gradient with within-condition independent leave-one-out baseline

utility.metric: unchanged v6 joint observation metric on actual decoded PNG and UTF8
utility.joint_risk_evaluation: compute task/view/scenario CE within each trained seed, then average across training seeds
utility.conditional_risk_evaluation: separately compute CE within each source/view over generation scenarios, then average

observer_qualification.fresh_qualification_sources: roles.observer_qualification; never used for task tuning or evaluation
observer_qualification.legacy_secondary_300_steps: recovery diagnostic only; a failing legacy qualification is retained

critic.loss: MSE on Z itself, not on log Z
critic.second_horizon_target: current stop outcome or frozen first-horizon predicted minimum at an actually observed child
critic.deployment: deterministic argmin of predicted conditional objective

oracle.scope: the same generator, initialization, sampled initial draft, horizon and finite continuation actions as evaluated policies
oracle.plans: all 21 sequences of 0, 1 or 2 non-stop continuation actions

statistics.bootstrap: crossed source-pair and training-seed resampling; all views, scenarios and conditions remain paired
statistics.primary_endpoint: net_utility joint CE; continuation action penalty is 0.002 utility units, not measured time
statistics.raw_utility_endpoint: separate descriptive joint CE, never retrospectively substituted for the primary endpoint
primary_family: output_ndu minus output_mean under fixed inference
statistics.other_comparisons: descriptive 95 percent intervals; no retrospective promotion
statistics.tails: exact fractional worst 10 percent and P95 at output level; source-mean tails separately
statistics.physical_completion_definition: valid original grayscale 56x28 PNG and valid nonempty UTF8 text; no grammar or truth requirement
statistics.task_success_definition: all text facts, image facts, relation and crossmodal disagreement exactly correct, with a valid caption grammar

execution_streams.tree_materialization: actual batched neural counterfactuals, every node decoded to persisted PNG and UTF8; policy reveal is limited to the committed branch
execution_streams.tree_randomness: owner-side independent stream per role, training seed, view and action prefix; matched across training arms; hidden from policies
execution_streams.observation_randomness: fixed role-specific seed shared across models and views; sources remain paired
execution_streams.generation_shape: source pairs repeated over independent generation scenarios; fixed batch shape within each role
execution_streams.fresh_cost_runs: batch-one resident closed-loop runs use the identical sampler law with distinct registered timing streams; no claim that batching gives bit-identical draws
execution_streams.tree_replay_cost: never treated as deployed compute; full materialization cost separately recorded
execution_streams.secondary_observer: offline scoring only, never used for generator, critic, static route or MPC selection

cost.inference: separate fresh resident executions include encoder, actual planner simulations, feature extraction, every decoder call, file write/fsync and reopen
cost.timing_sources: first 8 registered evaluation pairs; clean, noise, conflict_untrusted; 2 scenarios; 2 rounds
cost.timing_order: registered pseudorandom interleaving; no outlier deletion
cost.training: prospective whole-process wall/CPU plus nested stage breakdown; retained failed invocations
cost.unknown_historical_costs: remain unknown and are not imputed
cost.scientific_gate: quality and complete actual costs assessed together; action count is not an actual-time price

audio_video_scope: this registration closes image/text mechanism gaps only; natural AV, speech quality, native production admission and global optimality remain separate unpassed gates
